name: hydroxyl
label: +OH
effect: ↑ solubility, ↑ HBD count; can be oxidized by CYP

name: methyl
label: +CH3
effect: ↑ lipophilicity; minor steric block

name: amine_primary
label: +NH2
effect: ↑ solubility, basic at physiological pH (protonated NH3+); H-bond donor

name: amine_secondary
label: +NHR
effect: Basic, less H-donating than primary; common in opioids

name: amine_tertiary
label: +NR2
effect: Basic, ↑ logP, no H-donor

name: carboxyl
label: +COOH
effect: Acidic (pKa ~4.5), deprotonated at pH 7; ↑ solubility, ↓ permeability

name: amide
label: +C(=O)NH
effect: Stable peptide-like linkage, modest H-bonding

name: ester
label: +C(=O)O
effect: Hydrolyzed by esterases (often a prodrug strategy)

name: sulfonamide
label: +SO2NH2
effect: Mildly acidic NH; classical antibacterial pharmacophore (sulfonamide drugs)

name: fluorine
label: +F
effect: ↑ metabolic stability (blocks CYP oxidation), ↑ membrane permeability, ↓ pKa of nearby groups

name: chlorine
label: +Cl
effect: ↑ lipophilicity, ↑ metabolic stability, larger steric block than F

name: trifluoromethyl
label: +CF3
effect: Dramatic ↑ in lipophilicity + metabolic stability; common in modern drugs

name: cyano
label: +CN
effect: Strong electron-withdrawing, H-bond acceptor; can be a metabolic warhead

name: nitro
label: +NO2
effect: Common in nitroimidazole antibiotics (metronidazole) but also a PAINS/toxicophore alert in many contexts

name: phosphate
label: +PO3H2
effect: Highly polar, anionic; mimics nucleotide phosphate (nucleoside analogs)

name: methoxy
label: +OCH3
effect: H-bond acceptor; ↑ lipophilicity vs OH; common in cephamycins (7α-OMe)

name: boronic_acid
label: +B(OH)2
effect: Reversible covalent inhibitor of serine proteases / β-lactamases

name: morpholine
label: +morpholino
effect: Modest base, ↑ solubility, common solubilizing tail

name: piperazine
label: +piperazinyl
effect: Diamine, basic; widely used solubility/H-bond handle

name: guanidine
label: +guanidine
effect: Strongly basic (pKa ~13); used in arginine-mimetic drugs

name: tetrazole
label: +tetrazole
effect: Bioisostere of -COOH (similar pKa, ↑ membrane permeability)

name: siderophore_catechol
label: +catechol
effect: Iron-chelating catechol — TonB-dependent uptake into Gram-negatives (cefiderocol Trojan-horse strategy)
